review_type: Independent regression adjudication of final pipeline answers
blinding_limitations: The packet hides model labels, price, timing and automatic grades; no raw model reports or mapping files were read. The selected recipe was already known from coordination, so this is independent regression adjudication rather than fully blind model selection. No provider calls were made.
method: Read all 15 frozen questions and gold requirements, all 33 final claims, all 61 own selected exact quotations (including deterministically attached preceding spreadsheet rows), source attribution/locators and 9 routing explanations/drafts. Check scope, every numerical operand and units, completeness, abstention and recipient relevance manually. Match all 27 supplied distinct source contexts to the previously fully read and independently extracted24-document enrichment packet, and verify attribution against its frozen source gold. Exact quotation and routing-identity checks are supplementary mechanical checks, not semantic proof.
limitations: This small synthetic regression packet does not establish production accuracy or replace a broader independent human study.
Previously inspected holdout questions are now regression evidence; this review does not claim an untouched held-out score.
